kuchh samay ke liye balla haath mein nahin tha, lekin dil mein cricket aaj bhi jinda tha… 🥺❤️‍🩹
aaj jab filmi bat uthaya, to aisa laga jaise apne purane pyar se phir mulakat ho gai. 🏏✨

kuchh swapnil kalakar zaroor han, lekin junoon aaj bhi zinda hai! 🥹🫶🏻
#criketpremi #BackToCricket #CricketIsEmotion #UnfinishedDreams #CricketReels".
